_meta.mascot: Cinder, a grumpy lump of coal
_meta.secondary_persona: The Backlog, your pile of overdue cards, talks when you skip

variables.{due_yesterday}: cards due yesterday at the same check
variables.{deck}: deck with the most due cards
variables.{weakest_deck}: deck with the lowest retention this week
variables.{last_week_cards}: cards in the 7 days before that
variables.{best_day}: personal record cards in one day

_meta.spice: 1 = cheeky, 2 = guilt trip, 3 = unhinged. Set SPICE_MAX (repository variable) to cap it.
rules: Pick randomly inside a bucket, never repeat one of the last 5 sent.
routine fires about 30 min before the time the user usually studies (learned from the data).
partial fires only if done > 0 and done < goal, at least 2h after the last review.
save fires at 3h, 1h and 15 min before midnight local time, only if the goal is not met.
Max 2 non-save pushes per day. Save pushes are extra.
lapsed: day 1 = broken, then days 2, 3, 5, 7, then final, then silence except a weekly email.
Any review resets everything and triggers comeback or milestone if relevant.
Midnight is the deadline Cinder talks about; like Anki, reviews until 4:00 still count for the day (a quiet grace period).

routine.title: Cinder
routine.body: I'm cold. You know what warms me up? Flashcards.

routine.title: It's that time
routine.body: Same time as yesterday. Don't make it weird.

routine.title: {due} cards due
routine.body: They're waiting. I'm waiting. We're all just waiting.

routine.title: Cinder
routine.body: 10 minutes. I've watched you scroll for longer than that.

routine.title: Cinder
routine.body: Your brain is forgetting things right now. As we speak. That's the forgetting curve.

routine.title: Hey.
routine.body: Just checking you remember Anki exists. Because Anki remembers you.

routine.title: Cinder
routine.body: I'm a lump of coal. I have one job. So do you.

routine.title: Reminder
routine.body: Your {deck} cards asked about you. I said you were busy. I lied for you.

routine.title: Cinder
routine.body: Open Anki. I won't say it nicely twice.

routine.title: Cinder
routine.body: I know where your flashcards live. Would be a shame if they all came due at once.

partial.title: {done}/{goal}
partial.body: That's not a session, that's a warm-up.

partial.title: Almost
partial.body: {left} cards left. You stopped right before the good part.

partial.title: Half-lit
partial.body: I'm glowing on one side only. It's humiliating. Finish the set.

partial.title: Cinder
partial.body: You did {done} cards and left. Bold strategy.

partial.title: Cinder
partial.body: Almost doesn't count in streaks. It doesn't count anywhere, actually.

partial.title: {done} cards?
partial.body: I've seen better effort from a screensaver. {left} more.

partial.title: Cinder
partial.body: You opened Anki, did {done} cards and ghosted me. In this economy?

save_3h.title: 🔥 {streak} days
save_3h.body: Would be a shame to lose that. Just saying.

save_3h.title: Cinder
save_3h.body: I'm starting to smoke. Not the cool kind.

save_3h.title: 3 hours
save_3h.body: Plenty of time. That's what you said yesterday too, and look how close it got.

save_3h.title: Cinder
save_3h.body: I'm not saying I'm dying. I'm saying I've started writing a will.

save_1h.title: 1 hour left
save_1h.body: Your {streak}-day streak ends at midnight. I end with it.

save_1h.title: Cinder, flickering
save_1h.body: I can feel my edges going grey.

save_1h.title: Cinder
save_1h.body: Remember day 1? I do. I remember all {streak} of them.

save_1h.title: Cinder
save_1h.body: If I go out tonight, I'm haunting your review queue. Every. Single. Card.

save_15m.title: ⚠️ 15 minutes
save_15m.body: One session. That's all I'm asking.

save_15m.title: Last chance
save_15m.body: You're reading this, so you have time to open Anki. Do it now.

save_15m.title: Cinder
save_15m.body: This is not a drill. This is my last ember.

save_15m.title: Cinder
save_15m.body: {streak} days. Gone in 15 minutes. Because of you. No pressure.

broken.title: Streak: 0
broken.body: {streak} days, gone. Want to start a new one? Today counts.

broken.title: Cinder
broken.body: I went out last night. You were asleep. Cool. Cool cool cool.

broken.title: Cinder (ash)
broken.body: I'm ash now. Ash doesn't glow. Think about that.

broken.title: RIP Cinder
broken.body: Funeral is today. Dress code: open Anki and bring me back.

lapsed_day2.title: Day 2
lapsed_day2.body: {due} cards due. Tomorrow it'll be more. It's not personal, it's math.

lapsed_day2.title: Cinder
lapsed_day2.body: Still cold. Still here. Still judging.

lapsed_day3.title: The Backlog
lapsed_day3.body: Hi, it's your due pile. I'm {due} now. Yesterday I was {due_yesterday}. I'm growing.

lapsed_day3.title: Cinder
lapsed_day3.body: Your {deck} deck is packing its bags. I helped.

lapsed_day5.title: The Backlog
lapsed_day5.body: {due} cards. At this point I need my own postcode.

lapsed_day5.title: Cinder
lapsed_day5.body: I've started talking to the other coals. None of them have heard of you either.

lapsed_day7.title: A week
lapsed_day7.body: Your memory has been unsupervised for 7 days. It's been making poor choices.

lapsed_day7.title: The Backlog
lapsed_day7.body: {due} of us now. We've unionised. Our demand is that you show up.

final.title: Cinder
final.body: These reminders clearly aren't working. I'll stop. Just know I'm still here. Cold.

comeback.title: Cinder
comeback.body: Oh, so NOW you remember me. Fine. Day 1. Let's go.

comeback.title: The Backlog
comeback.body: You came back. I was {due_yesterday}. I am... still {due}. Keep going.

goal_done.title: Goal hit ✅
goal_done.body: I'm glowing. Go live your life.

goal_done.title: Cinder
goal_done.body: Fine. That was decent. Don't let it go to your head.

goal_done.title: Cinder
goal_done.body: Streak safe. I'll stop bothering you. Until tomorrow.

stats.title: So close
stats.body: {to_best} cards and today beats your record of {best_day}.

stats.title: Retention: {retention}%
stats.body: It dropped. Your memory would like to file a complaint.

stats.title: Cinder
stats.body: Weakest deck this week: {weakest_deck}. It's not going to fix itself.

stats.title: Weekly report
stats.body: {week_cards} cards this week. Last week: {last_week_cards}. Explain yourself.

3.title: Cinder is warm
3.body: 3 days. I'm not saying I like you. I'm just warm.

7.title: 🔥 Cinder → Smoulder
7.body: A whole week. I have an actual flame now. Don't make it weird.

14.title: Two weeks
14.body: 14 days. Other coals are asking who my person is.

30.title: 🔥🔥 Cinder → Blaze
30.body: 30 days. People are roasting marshmallows on me. I allow it.

100.title: 🔥🔥🔥 Cinder → Inferno
100.body: 100 days. I'm visible from space. Probably.

365.title: 🌋 Cinder → Volcano
365.body: 365 days. I'm a volcano now. Your forgetting curve should be nervous.

email.subject: Your {streak}-day streak has 3 hours to live
email.preview: Cinder is smoking. Not in a cool way.

email.subject: We need to talk about your {due} overdue cards
Your memory has been unsupervised for a week
Your week with Cinder: {week_cards} cards, {retention}% retention
email.preview: Plus the deck that's quietly falling apart.
